mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_product_rule_tombstone ( product_rule_id, customer_id, customer_code, rule_name, rule_snapshot, manifest_hash, quarantine_reason, quarantined_at ) VALUES ( #{productRuleId}, #{customerId}, #{customerCode}, #{ruleName}, #{ruleSnapshot}, #{manifestHash}, #{quarantineReason}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM customer_product_rule_tombstone WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND restored_at IS NULL ORDER BY quarantined_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM customer_product_rule_tombstone WHERE restored_at IS NULL ORDER BY quarantined_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM customer_product_rule_tombstone WHERE product_rule_id = #{productRuleId} AND restored_at IS NULL ORDER BY quarantined_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_product_rule_tombstone WHERE restored_at IS NULL
